node.doctext:
if (@_&& ref @_ ne ‘ARRAY’) {

No, not quite, ref @_ won't do what you want. If you wanted to check that a function was called with exactly one argument that is an arrayref: if ( @_==1 && ref $_[0] eq 'ARRAY' ) { ... }
